VBO:0201026.summary: Alert and lively, Podencos are a family of Spanish hunting dogs whose character varies by regional breed. The Andaluz is affectionate and loyal to its handler, while the Canario brings an energetic, tireless working spirit. These dogs use scent, hearing and sight to find quarry, especially rabbits; the Ibicenco is prized for agile work in dense cover.
VBO:0201026.shortDescription: An alert Spanish hunting family with varied temperaments, keen senses and a long association with rabbit hunting.
